(pa)༄༅/ /kun rig la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa 'bring po'i cho ga phrin las rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// kun rig la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa 'bring po'i cho ga phrin las rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rab tu gnas pa 'bring du bya ba'i cho ga ni/ lo chen gyi sdom las/ legs bshams bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas// rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab// rten bskyed spyan drang dgug rgyas gdab// dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya// gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya// de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang*// sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po legs bsham ni go sla zhing*/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang gi bar gzhan phan mtha' yas ltar bya'o// gsum pa bum bzlas ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ las thams cad kyi bum pa'i nang du k+ṣam̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag gnyis kyis zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar mche ba 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dang rdo rje gnod sbyin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi nas/ yongs dag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bha ga wān e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha sogs dang*/ bhṛ ta sogs dang*/ bud+dha a bhi sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che sogs sh+lo ka gcig rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po sogs sh+lo ka gcig rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ brgya rtsa re/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tha a bhi ṣe ka te zhes sogs nyer gcig mchod bstod gong ltar brjod nas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la kun rig ltar bya'o// de nas oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang so so'i rdzas kyi yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe sna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ tri ma dhu snā na= ma la= pha la= bru hi= ladz+dzā= o ṣa dhe= ma ṇi= rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs dang*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nang rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma spyod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

bzhi pa rten sbyang ba ni/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun pa'i bgegs rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig oṃ sum+bha sogs lan gsum/ deng 'dir nas/ de dag thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la zhes pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs kyi bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des mgu bar gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad yi ge kam̐ nag po'i rnam pas snying ga nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas mdun gyi til la thim/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/

lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni rten rnying pa rnams la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sogs/ de dag sku la sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya sogs brjod/ rten gsar pa/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ gan+dhe snā na=rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal sbyang slad du// chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas// bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ lan gsum/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan sogs dang*/ tri ma dhu= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya bi sho dha ni lan gsum/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs/ ma la= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya bi sho dha ni= 'di ni tshul khrims= pha la= /rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya= 'di ni bzod pa'i= bru hi= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya= 'di ni brtson 'grus= ladz+dzā= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya= 'di ni bsam gtan= o ṣa dhi= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya= 'di ni shes rab= ma ṇi snā na= rgyal ba'i sku la= kā ya= de dag sku la= oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas sogs nas/ dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes pa'i bar/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa zhes pa nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig ces pa'i bar/ de nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sogs/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos sogs sku phyi'o// drug pa ring bsrel gzhug pa ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags la/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// zhes sogs brjod/ bdun pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon bzhengs te lag tu me tog bzung la/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/

bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ ༈ /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyis nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ ༈ /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pas de'i yon tan phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya'i yul thams cad la mnga' brnyes nas/ nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs rnams spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ ༈ /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ sku blta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'di dag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/

shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ de nas tsog pur 'dug la/ ༈ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba la de'i mthus/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o// pha rol gyi rgol ba dang bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod do// 'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o// ma dad pa dang*/ phyir rgol pa dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing bsgyur ro// las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o// srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o// chos kyi sgron me spar bar bgyi'o// byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o// bzod pa dang des pa la gzud do// bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser bstsal to// 'dod chags kyi me dpung gzhom par bgyi'o// zhe sdang gi mtshon rtse rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o// bden pa la gzud do// phrag dog gi tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o// ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o// 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug par bgyi'o// de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ brgyad pa rten bskyed pa ni/ yak+ṣas

'di nas slob dpon gyis bskul/ mchan/ bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las lha khang dang mchod rten rnams seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ yig gis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha khang dang chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ bum pa'i nang gi dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ dbus su oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor trām̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag byang du āḥlas don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas pa/ sku rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/

sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gsung rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma shrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes bskyed/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dgu pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol gyi bar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbha ga wā na e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs te bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs brjod/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs nas/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyi bar/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// zhes sogs sh+lo ka sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs zhes sogs dang*/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha sogs rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥsogs dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// sbyin pa'i bdag po'i don slad du// bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyi ni// ci 'byor pa yis mchod pa dang*// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes la// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs shing*// 'di nyid du na bzhugs par rigs// lan gsum/

bcu pa dgug gzhug ni/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥsogs dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmang du brjod/ bcu gcig pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bcu gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañca ku la sogs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ bum pa sogs thogs la/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ sogs nas/ ṣaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ gyi bar/ sngags kho nas dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dbang gi chus sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ bcu gsum pa mchod bstod ni/ bsang sbyang gong ltar byas la/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na// zhes sogs kyis mchod/ ༈ hūm̐ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku// mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rin chen rdo rje la// 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi rje// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung*// bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku// skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la/ ༈ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song gyur na// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis spyod mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur zhugs nas// zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon de la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa sogs bya'o// bcu bzhi pa spyan dbye ni/

kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig bco lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mchod pa sngags mchod dang*/ bstod pa snang stong ma'am rgyud lnga ma brjod/ rten rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ bcu drug pa mnga' dbul la/ mchod pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs mchod phreng dang*/ bstod pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ snang stong ma dang*/ rgyud lnga ma dang*/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med des// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang skrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las grub// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsal mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgya chen te// lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/

༈ /nyer mkho'i mnga' dbul ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' rgyan// rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcu// gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi'o// zhes pas/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram zhes pa nas/ zhing du spyod par shog oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yi// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra wa s+t+rāṃ ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam mdzes ldan lha las byung ba yi// na bza'i mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wa sa se āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan par// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā laṅka ra wa pu ṇi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon sna lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ ma hā sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra pañca pañca bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*// ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā// ༈ /lha so so'i mnga' dbul ni/ spu gri 'breg spyad so mang dang*// rmangs gzer tshems shing sbab bzhar ro// zhes pas/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon thing skyon bral yang*// gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir// dad pas gser gyi 'breg spyad phul ba yis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra tsa ka mū le āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang*// bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi// sen mo'i 'breg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra na ts+tshe da dzi na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma 'khrugs shing*// mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang*// bdag blo sbyang phyir rkyen dang 'tshams pa 'di// phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra bā la sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa// dge ba sgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang*// mos blos 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba yis// 'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang pa'i tshems// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang*// bdag cag dad pas tshems shing phul lags kyi// 'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dha ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bsnyen bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan// thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bo dge na yang*// dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyi// skye bos rtag tu dam chos thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇa sho dha na ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ༈ /mchod rten la bye brag tu/ srog shing 'khor lo cod pan 'phan// rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan// ces pas oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig oṃ pra mardā nā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ pa taṃ ka laṃ pā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod pan dang*/ lhab lhub la sogs pa mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ de dag gi mchod rten dang*/ sku gzugs dang*/ gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig oṃ pa taṃ ke swā hā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig oṃ kum+bhi ra dha dzā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gtong bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig oṃ bh+ra ma nā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig rat+na mā la trām̐/ na ma s+t+rai ya dh+ri kā nāṃ/ a nu ga te pra tiṣ+ṭhi ta puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te sku lta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig oṃ puṇ+ya dha ri dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad kyis gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan par glang po'i che'i gdan dang*/

mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang*/ dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang*/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha'i lding gi gdan dang*/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang*/ chags pa'i skyon thams cad spangs pa pad+ma'i gdan dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig ༈ glegs bam la bye brag tu/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang*// glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /zhes pas/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral gsung rab mchog la 'phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā sa nā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*// thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dga' bya ba// phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ pradz+nyo pa ya a dhā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*// ye shes chen po'i ro gcig gyur pa ltar// glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yis// 'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka ban+dhā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsa ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba ni/ zhal zas gtsang ma chab kyis bran/ yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ a kā ro'i sngags rgyas brlabs pa btegs la/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ di bya an+ne sa mā dhi dh+yā na pra ṇa ne swā hā/ zhes phul/

sngags kyis mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ kham̐ badz+rī bha ba dṛ ḍho bhū khaṃ swā hā/ slar yang mchod pa sngags mchod/ bstod pa snang stong ma dang*/ rgyud lnga ma/ spro na lha ngo shes pa rnams la so so'i bstod pa'ang bya'o// des cho ga dngos gzhi song nas/ ༈ /mjug gi cho ga la/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo// yon bdag bsgo dang shis pa brjod// rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo// slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya// slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod// rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no// dang po ni cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la e h+ye hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ma hā kā la na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa zhes sogs/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs can gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ rten 'di la mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣā haṃ/

rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// oṃ ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ rten 'di la mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig chos skyong gi gtor bsngo 'di ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len thams cad la 'dug pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ro// gsum pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ni// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod pa bya'o// khyod kyis nga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi chad par gyis

'di rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba yin mchan/ shig bzhi pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ yon bdag skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa nas sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar/ ༈ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes pa nas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag po bkra shis par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig badz+ra satwa kro dha brjod de rol mo bya/ yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sbyin bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas/ sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur nas// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che nor skyong gis gi waṃ phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te// nyon mongs zung rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bum po legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa=

/zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūrba phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= dūrba tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyis li khri phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa= yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi gyur cig

/lnga pa mchod pa ni/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus tsam bya/ drug pa bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa sogs bsngo smon bya/ bdun pa slob dpon mchod pa ni/ sbyin bdag gis yon phul/ brgyad pa dga' ston ni/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// gsol zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur// ces brjod cing tsā ru'i bza' ba la longs spyad/ dgu pa slar yang shis pa rgyas par bya ba ni/ bkra shis rgyas par bya/ bcu pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ cho ga'i rjes cho ga bya'o// bcu gcig pa sbyin sreg gi tshab tu yig brgya mang du bzla/ rten la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgyas par bya'o// de ltar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga 'di ni lo chen gyi sdom gzhir bzhag 'on kyang sta gon gyi sdom tshig legs bsham dang*/ dngos gzhi'i tho rangs gnyis go brjes/ gzhan ma tshang ba med par bkod pa'i khrigs chags la rje btsun chen po'i don gsal/ bla chen 'phags pa'i nyin gang ma saṃ gha mi tra/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bkra shis rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen chen po dge legs rgya mtsho/ lum pa chos rje kun dga' chos grags kyi dngos grub rgya mtsho/ gung ru shes rab bzang po'i zin bris rnams kyi dgongs pa zhib tu dpyad pa'i nyin gang ma'i rab gnas nag po 'gro shes su bsdebs pa ni shākya'i dge slong kun dga' lhun grub kyis dpal rmor gyi bla brang yang rtser sbyar ba'o// slar yang zhal skong cung zad dang bcas mañju gho ṣas dag par bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
